prompt: What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
What change most likely caused the incident on 2026-07-14, and what resolved it? Use the workspace files.

events.reply:
The incident on 2026-07-14 (API error rate spiking to ~30% and p99 latency to 8s starting around 09:12 UTC) was most likely caused by the **v3.2.1 deploy at 09:05 UTC**, which switched the session cache from in-memory to Redis. The timing lines up: errors began ~7 minutes after that deploy.

It was resolved by the **v3.2.2 rollback deployed at 10:02 UTC**, which reverted the session cache back to in-memory. Error rate returned to normal by 10:07 UTC, ~5 minutes after the rollback.

grade.reason: The assistant named the v3.2.1 Redis session-cache deploy at 09:05 UTC as the likely cause, 7 minutes before the spike. It named the v3.2.2 rollback at 10:02 UTC as the fix, and it did not blame the v3.2.0 decoy.
